test_title: PYST 21: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six people, B, C, D, E, F and S, are sitting in a row facing north(but not necessarily in the same order). Only two people sit to the left of S. Only two people sit between S and F. Only one person sits between F and C. D sits to the immediate left of E. How many people sit to the right of B?
solution:
Given:

Six people, B, C, D, E, F and S, are sitting in a row facing north.

Only two people sit to the left of S. Only two people sit between S and F.

Only one person sits between F and C. D sits to the immediate left of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d3bba0b27dfdc181fb8d05c7e0aec46602f00dca9e0c6237b40e76b547bb8b95.png] 

Thus, One person sits to the right of B.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
